description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three language models—EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 (dark blue), SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) (light blue), and a third model represented by gray bars (whose label is partially obscured but appears to be a baseline or reference model)—across six evaluation benchmarks: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG (average score). The vertical axis represents performance scores ranging from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.50 and 1.00, and exact values labeled above each bar. For PT-EVAL, scores are 0.42 (dark blue), 0.46 (light blue), and 1.00 (gray). For KoBEST-BQ: 0.52, 0.56, 1.00. For KoBEST-CP: 0.71, 0.74, 1.00. For KoBEST-HS: 0.50, 0.54, 1.00. For KoBEST-SN: 0.69, 0.73, 1.00. For AVG: 0.57, 0.61, 1.00. The gray bars consistently reach 1.00 across all benchmarks, suggesting they represent normalized or ideal performance, while the dark blue and light blue bars show relative performance of the two models, with EEVE-Korean generally outperforming SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 on most tasks except PT-EVAL. The chart is organized with grouped bars for each benchmark, and the legend at the bottom identifies the color coding for each model.
